description: Declarative mappings (openctem.io/mapping/v2, docs/mapping.md): a mapping file and a tool output to the CTIS report and the counts Apply gives, or an error category (mapping: the mapping file is refused; input: the input is refused as a whole). Issues are compared by record and rule; their messages are informative and not part of the vectors. Members ending in _file name a file relative to this directory.

cases.name: sample findings-jsonl
sample generic-csv
sample generic-json
sample json-each
sample junit-xml
sample naabu-jsonl
jsonl: one finding per line, the asset made canonical and added once
asset type from the value form: address, origin, domain, else unclassified
no asset_value: the default unclassified asset mapping-import
no asset_value with Options.DefaultAsset
a value with no canonical form skips the finding with an issue
predicates: exists, equals compares as text, in, matches, all must hold
a predicate on an object or a list is false
every rule whose predicate holds emits a record, in rule order
transforms: first, trim, lower, upper
transforms: split, map (unmapped items dropped), join
an unmapped scalar is missing and the default applies
as integer: numbers and numeric strings, fractions are missing
as boolean and as string
max_bytes cuts on a UTF-8 boundary
template: variables filled, a missing variable makes the value missing
vulnerability.ids: raw ids become typed ids
evidence text becomes one raw_text evidence item
control characters: removed from text, turned into spaces elsewhere
identity: a finding whose identity members are all empty is skipped
json: each names the list of records
json: a top-level list is the records
jsonl: a line that is not JSON is skipped with an issue
csv: auto delimiter, BOM, quoted cells, empty cells left out
csv: skip_rows, trimmed, empty and repeated column names
csv: a cell beyond the header is ignored with an issue
xml: attributes, text, repeated elements
xml: a document type declaration fails the input
a version 1 mapping is refused
an unknown member of a mapping is refused
a constant fingerprint is refused
a reference member is not settable
observe lists the input fields and the unmapped ones
